status: partial; do not use as a calibration freeze or replace T3 parameters yet

t3_terminal_identity.status: source-visible 20-port external interface candidate; internal magnetic graph and parameters unqualified
t3_terminal_identity.screen_result: No joint sampled EHT, TBY7 current and C21 match in seven completed eight-sign cases or five completed booster-turn cases; prescribed-drive sensitivities do not qualify installed turns, returns or periodic state.

mode.name: S550 2 kByte
mode.argument: The manual gives 46.5 us write plus 16.0 us retrace per line, and 18.0 ms display plus 1.5 ms retrace per field for the 2 kByte mode.

horizontal_oscillator_t1.evidence: documented C16 and manual range set the ideal scale; the source-connected isolated oscillator gives a conditional loaded stage response
horizontal_oscillator_t1.limitation: C16 is coupled through R21 and a provisional transistor network. The loaded 1.45 mH is not an original winding specification, a connected-sync result, or a Phase B calibration freeze.

horizontal_driver_t2.conditional_primary_source_edges: T2 primary top follows R23=62 ohm; bottom meets V13 collector. The secondary seam and polarity remain unverified.
horizontal_driver_t2.evidence: design-derived primary operating bounds from documented R23 and line rate; isolated source-connected driver-stage sensitivity
horizontal_driver_t2.limitation: The isolated stage omits V18 base/output loading and misses TP15's manual range. Ratio, secondary loss, coupling, polarity and core behavior remain unqualified; this is not an A3 score or T2 calibration.

horizontal_feed_l1.conditional_source_branch: 41P -> R42 (6.8 ohm) -> L1 -> C22 (220 uF) -> 00; the flyback-hot crossing is kept separate by a functional stress check
equations: R_L1 <= 0.1 * R42 for no more than 10% added DC series drop
horizontal_feed_l1.evidence: design-derived operating bounds from documented R42/C22 and native line rate, conditional on the page-4 no-junction crossing
horizontal_feed_l1.limitation: The original choke values, C22 ESR, core saturation and connected flyback loading remain unknown; this isolated passive-filter calculation is not an output-stage calibration.

horizontal_linearity_l3.conditional_branch: L3 parallels R35=82 ohm +/-5% between h_hot and h_linout in the current KiCad page-4 graph; full independent page comparison remains open
horizontal_linearity_l3.evidence: design-derived upper operating bound using the documented 16 us retrace and 82 ohm +/-5% R35
horizontal_linearity_l3.limitation: The 25% shunt-current and 2% series-resistance budgets are engineering choices. Original L3 values and connected output-stage behavior are unknown.

horizontal_base_compensation_l4.conditional_branch: Selected E2 setting places L4:1 and L4:2 in parallel between h_outputbase and h_outbase; L4:3 is bridged and has no modeled effect
horizontal_base_compensation_l4.evidence: conditional design-derived operating bound against BU508AF-class inductive switching comparator; not original L4 values or a measured T2 output
horizontal_base_compensation_l4.limitation: E2 selection, original choke behavior, coupling, loaded T2 secondary drive and V18 base current remain unqualified.

horizontal_resonance.c30_population_assumption: populated in the current KiCad/output-stage candidate; the physical K7222.11 population is unverified

c27_only_alternative.qualification: conditional alternative; the loaded 5 ms stage changes final EHT by about 2.5% when C30 is absent, but neither population nor periodic operation is established

horizontal_resonance.evidence: design-derived from documented timing and printed capacitor values; C27 collector-to-00 branch has a scoped page-4 source comparison, while C30 parallel placement and population remain unverified
horizontal_resonance.limitation: This is the effective resonance of the entire horizontal network, not a measurement or direct assignment of yoke inductance. The 2.36 mH candidate requires C30 to be populated; the C27-only alternative is 2.59 mH. Resolve the optional C30 population from source evidence before selecting either.

candidate_41p_feed_v.tier: nominal ideal rail plus cross-revision K7222.25 operating comparator

candidate_c21_differential_v.source: older.pdf page 4 handwritten Booster-C C21 annotation

candidate_trace_node_v.equation: V(h_boost) = V(41P) + V(C21); source-addressed C21 joins h_feed to h_boost

collector_flyback.evidence: design-derived ideal LC approximation; 60–70 V is across C21 in the .11 handwritten page-4 annotation and the later AE9VT description, while 39–43 V is a cross-revision 41P operating comparator
collector_flyback.limitation: The actual C21 voltage and collector trace supply have not been verified in a settled .11 stage. Corrected 20-port prescribed-drive screens do not jointly match sampled EHT, TBY7 current and C21, and cannot qualify the 60–70 V operating point. Loss, loading, damper conduction and transformer coupling change the pulse; neither ideal case is a measured collector peak.

high_voltage_ratio.status: historical conditional EHT-to-collector-voltage proxy; not an installed T3 turns ratio
high_voltage_ratio.evidence: design-derived from manual EHT target and candidate ideal collector pulse
high_voltage_ratio.limitation: V21's source-visible anode/cathode pads are X3:1/X3:2, not the X1:1/X1:2 pads used by the historical 19-port graph. The 17.49–21.78 calculation divides EHT by an ideal collector-to-ground pulse; it cannot establish an HV-to-drive turns ratio without the HV cold end, the X2:4 differential drive waveform, source-corrected winding continuity and settled loading.

conditional_t3_hv_turn_scale.status: historical 19-port graph sensitivity; invalid as a current 20-port winding proposal
conditional_t3_hv_turn_scale.evidence: conditional design-derived ratio sweep using the high_voltage_ratio calculation and an isolated 1 V pulse
conditional_t3_hv_turn_scale.limitation: The 64 drive turns, boost voltage, historical 19-port T3 graph and loaded EHT are unverified. The source-visible X3:1 V21 anode and X1:2–X2:3 conductor supersede that graph. These absolute turns cannot qualify the 20-port candidate or freeze T3.

conditional_t3_polarity_screen.status: historical 19-port graph sensitivity: 8 of 16 relative-polarity candidates survived; no current winding selection
conditional_t3_polarity_screen.source_path: Page 4 places T3 X2:7 on the V18 collector and V17 cathode; the corrected V21 pads are X3:1/X3:2. The earlier X1:1/X1:2 V21 identification used by this screen is superseded.
conditional_t3_polarity_screen.functional_rule: Within the superseded 19-port graph only, a positive X2:7-to-X2:4 pulse was required to make X1:1 positive relative to X1:16. This is not a source-corrected V21 sign rule.
conditional_t3_polarity_screen.rejection_reason: The other eight reverse the high-voltage winding voltage under the historical 19-port graph's positive collector pulse and its now-superseded V21 pad mapping.
conditional_t3_polarity_screen.limitation: The isolated 1 V pulse checks only the historical graph's sign. The drawn upper conductor is X1:2–X2:3, and V21's anode is X3:1. The accepted IDs do not select signs for the 20-port candidate and must be recomputed after its internal graph and returns are bounded.

conditional_t3_g1_polarity_screen.status: historical 19-port graph sensitivity: 4 of 16 candidates survived combined HV and negative-G1 filters; no current winding selection
conditional_t3_g1_polarity_screen.functional_rule: Within the historical X2:5-to-00 return hypothesis, a positive collector flyback pulse must make X2:6 negative relative to X2:5 so V14 can pull the G1 brightness branch negative during retrace.
conditional_t3_g1_polarity_screen.rejection_reason: The four HV-compatible candidates with opposite auxiliary sign make X2:6 positive under the prescribed positive collector pulse, the wrong phase for V14 to generate negative UG1 through the current return path.
conditional_t3_g1_polarity_screen.limitation: Page 4 establishes V14's external rectifier path and a cross-revision Robotron description corroborates its purpose, but X2:5 grounding and auxiliary internal continuity remain hypotheses. These IDs inherit the source-contradicted 19-port HV filter; they cannot select a 20-port sign. The 1 V isolated check establishes sign only, not TP17 amplitude or a source-verified T3 graph.

14.role: feedback waveform; path to T3 needs source review

15.role: driver collector; cannot directly specify an auxiliary winding ratio

17.role: rectified flyback-derived pulse; source polarity and loading need review

yoke_class_comparator.scope: Philips 1987 31 cm, 90-degree, 20 mm-neck, 12 kV monochrome yokes; not an identification of AE9VT
yoke_class_comparator.argument: The Philips AT1077/05 sheet gives 257 x 195 mm full scan at 12 kV and the selection guide supplies a same-size 20 mm-neck family. A first-order scan-size and square-root-EHT transfer spans the printed Robotron picture tolerances and 11-12 kV target. The active 4.007 mH/2 ohm horizontal yoke lies outside the comparable family; the 19.987 mH/10 ohm vertical yoke lies inside. A conditional 475 uH/0.8 ohm winding still clips at 90.87 mm half-width with the 40 mm field; at 34.7 mm it reaches 105 mm at 1.836 A peak, only 0.46% below the assumed neck-clip current. These are class comparison bounds, not installed AE9VT values or a geometry freeze.

vertical_yoke_conditional.status: conditional reduced-geometry design point; not a yoke calibration or connected-stage score

tp7_total_sense_current_swing_a.qualification: R27 also senses R29 shunt and feedback currents, so this is not an isolated yoke-current target

vertical_yoke_conditional.evidence: design-derived within the assumed 40 mm cosine-sheet yoke, 10 mm internal neck aperture, 20 mH/10 ohm winding and reduced electron trajectory
vertical_yoke_conditional.limitation: The physical tube/yoke geometry and winding are not established. The manual's 17 V TP8 arrow ends at zero rather than the negative trough; its separate 10 V arrow has unresolved node attribution. A TP7/TP8 differential-swing bound cannot be derived from those annotations, so this calculation cannot freeze the vertical operating point.

geometry_diagnostic.status: default model misses documented width; shorter-field trial narrowly reaches it but remains unqualified

tube_outline_candidate.implication: An internal beam aperture cannot be 12 mm radius; even the maximum outer radius is 10.4 mm. The B31-G family maximum overall length is 253 mm, shorter than the active model's 280 mm gun-to-screen distance. Exact B31G22 inner glass radius and gun position are unknown.

geometry_diagnostic.method: Binary search of trajectory.ray() to the neck-aperture boundary; 0.2, 0.1 and 0.05 mm integration steps agree on half-width within 1 nm.
geometry_diagnostic.evidence: design-derived from documented width and explicitly assumed geometry; not a physical B31G22 measurement

shorter_field_trial.method: Recompute the cosine-sheet yoke at 34.7 mm active length; binary-search the trajectory current and neck-clip boundary at 11.5 kV, 350 V G2 and 4 kV focus. 0.2, 0.1 and 0.05 mm integration steps agree to sub-nanometre half-width.
shorter_field_trial.qualification: mathematically feasible only for the unverified 10 mm internal neck aperture and assumed 280 mm beam-origin-to-screen distance; margin to neck clipping and winding fill limit is small

geometry_diagnostic.conclusion: The default 40 mm yoke field clips before the 210 mm documented width. A 12 mm internal neck radius is excluded by the family outline drawing. Shortening the assumed active field to 34.7 mm reaches 105 mm half-width in the reduced model, but does not establish the real tube inner aperture, yoke extent or installed geometry; no peak current is frozen.

conditional_axial_geometry_screen.status: B31-G family outline sensitivity only; installed B31G22/AE9VT gun, yoke and current remain unqualified
conditional_axial_geometry_screen.source_context: The K7222.11 page-18 assembly labels B31G22 and AE9VT. A scanned B31-G family outline gives 253 mm maximum overall length, while Philips A31-410W gives 233 mm for a different 110-degree comparator. Neither drawing locates the installed gun or magnetic field.
conditional_axial_geometry_screen.limitation: The 250, 230 and 200 mm paths are sensitivity choices, not B31G22 measurements. Field start, internal neck radius, winding sensitivity and screen shape remain assumptions; the 90-degree Philips yoke electrical/current class is not an installed AE9VT limit.

remaining_design_work: Resolve or carry bounded alternatives for the source-visible 20-port T3 tap/return map, X1:16 manual mapping, X2:4 drive and settled C21 voltage before fixing turns or winding polarities; the historical eight- and four-candidate 19-port sign filters do not select the corrected graph.

Bound B31G22 gun-to-screen distance, inner neck aperture and AE9VT axial field extent before choosing geometry: the current 280 mm beam path exceeds the named B31-G family's 253 mm maximum overall length. At 250 mm the conditional model needs at most 29.87 mm active field, at 230 mm at most 26.55 mm, and at 200 mm at most 21.64 mm; the installed values remain unknown. The active 4.007 mH/2 ohm winding is outside the cited 31 cm/90-degree yoke class, which is only a sensitivity comparator.

Validate the conditional vertical operating point against sourced tube/yoke bounds and a connected TP7/TP8 differential waveform; test points 1–6 constrain upstream stage waveforms rather than yoke current directly.
Check each derived quantity against the source and replace placeholder T3 parameters only after the constraints are mutually consistent.
